descriptions.headlineDispositionAware: Single-tenant portfolio headline: disposition-aware open + needs-evidence estimated USD from the latest committed run per system (cap 200). Excludes remediated, waived, deferred, and accepted-risk findings.
descriptions.systemRowSnapshotPotential: Per-system component: estimated USD from each system's latest committed findings snapshot before disposition partitioning. Rows do not sum to the portfolio headline.
descriptions.crossTenantPortfolioHeadline: Cross-tenant portfolio headline: sums the same disposition-aware open + needs-evidence basis per accessible tenant (k-anonymity ≥ 5). Not comparable to value-report hours ROI.
descriptions.trailing30DayFindingEvents: Trailing 30-day UTC activity: distinct finding IDs resolved via review trail or discovered on committed runs. Counts only — not USD savings.
descriptions.valueReportActivityWindowGeneric: Tenant activity window (UTC): architect hours saved and annualized ROI-model USD for the requested period. Distinct from sponsor-report disposition-aware USD headline.
descriptions.pilotScorecardUtcWindowGeneric: Pilot scorecard UTC window: run volume and committed-manifest counts for the period. Does not emit disposition-aware USD headline totals.

nonAdditivityCaveat: Per-system rows do not sum to the portfolio headline.

operatorHints.dispositionTraining: Headline savings follow finding dispositions — for example, accepted risk and waived items are excluded from realized value. Portfolio totals deduplicate overlapping findings by stable FindingId. Per-system rows are pre-disposition snapshots and do not add up to the portfolio headline because of shared infrastructure and overlapping findings.
operatorHints.headlineMath: Headline savings are disposition-aware: accepted risk, waived, deferred, and not-applicable findings are excluded from realized totals. Open and needs-evidence amounts use portfolio finding deduplication by stable FindingId (not cross-review compare correlation) so shared infrastructure is not counted twice.
operatorHints.systemRowMath: Each row is a pre-disposition snapshot from that system's latest committed review. Row amounts do not sum to the portfolio headline because headline totals apply disposition rules and deduplicate overlapping findings by FindingId.
